smallest_sound_behavior.description: per declared path resolve <commit>:<path> to blob OID in trusted and candidate; compare OID strings; never read or decode content
smallest_sound_behavior.ordering: validate trusted commit and resolve its declared sources first (failure -> exit 2 per exit_map 'invalid trusted commit/source'); validate candidate commit (failure -> exit 2); per-path candidate resolution failure or OID mismatch -> exit 1; all equal -> exit 0 with EXECUTOR_SOURCE_BOUND

verified.symlink_note: symlink blob content is its target path; OID differs from trusted regular file naturally
verified.directory_note: tree OID vs blob OID mismatches -> DRIFT, matching 'missing/nonregular'
